archetypes.reason: Requested categories are optional. Preserve measured order and threshold pattern signatures; do not invent additional immediate/weak/hold thresholds or exclusive taxonomy.

frozen.decisionPrice: exact saved PIT Decision Price; not first subsequent OPEN; no artificial zero-price endpoint inserted
frozen.membership: exact original saved 3800 identities per arm; no future availability used for selection
frozen.rank: 1..5 by within-timestamp order in original arm array, verified against saved frozen scores descending and symbol tie-break; never use union armRank overwritten by another arm

nextStep: Propose exactly one A/B/C/D/E after describing evidence and limitations; no causal rule, fitting, validation or strategy work. Path existence can motivate a separate PIT recoverability diagnostic but cannot establish profitability.

order.extremaTies: earliest bar attaining exact same minimum/maximum; save every tied bar interval and tie counts; classification describes first attainment, not unique extreme times
order.sameBar: unknown even if bar open/close might suggest an order; no intrabar interpolation

orderedPatterns.allOriginalBounds: confirmed count / original3800 lower bound; confirmed+same-bar+incomplete count / original3800 upper bound; descriptive partial identification, not binomial independent CI
orderedPatterns.confirmed: exists qualifying first event in a strictly earlier bar than qualifying second event; save earliest lexicographic witness pair
orderedPatterns.globalVsThresholdOrder: ordered threshold events do not require global low before global high
orderedPatterns.negative: NOT_OBSERVED only on complete path; missing path remains NOT_EVALUABLE
orderedPatterns.thresholdReference: all thresholds relative to the same original Decision Price
orderedPatterns.unknown: no confirmed pair but both thresholds in the same bar => SAME_BAR_ORDER_UNKNOWN

path.end: 15:00 before 2024-11-05, 15:30 thereafter; same saved regular-session semantics, no next-session or auction supplement
path.invalid: retain every original row with NO_VALID_PATH, exact reason/missing slots; metrics null. Partial observed extrema separately marked bounds only, never pooled with complete paths
path.lowToHigh: 100*((1+selectionToHigh/100)/(1+selectionToLow/100)-1); unordered oracle range, including HIGH_THEN_LOW; not realizable return
path.selectionToHigh: maximum future high relative to Decision Price, without clamping at zero
path.selectionToLow: minimum future low relative to Decision Price, without clamping at zero
path.sessionEndReturn: last regular close relative to Decision Price; gross reference return, not fill-based profit; no cost subtracted from geometric ranges
path.source: same hash-pinned normalized 5m projector and saved raw Development cache
path.start: bars start >= decision timestamp; no selecting bar from the past; at 11:30 first future regular bar is 12:30
path.valid: every expected regular 5m slot exists and is valid; sparse 5m bars with >=1 observed minute accepted per original normalizer, counted explicitly

random.bootstrap: 10000 session-cluster resamples seed20260919; pointwise descriptive CI plus circular 5-session block sensitivity
random.fullPopulation: NOT_IDENTIFIED; no missing imputation, no availability reranking
random.primary: same timestamp both original Top5 fully complete through session end; zero pairs => NOT_EVALUABLE
random.secondary: observed original complete-path members at common timestamps, both arms at least1; explicitly observation-conditional, not Top5 policy estimate
random.source: same original Random Top5, seed20260919 repetitions1, no redraw
random.weights: timestamp equal within session, session equal across sessions

statistics.dependence: overlapping timestamps and repeated symbols not independent; no row-iid significance claims
statistics.orderRates: valid complete paths denominator; also all-original status counts
statistics.primary: row-weighted descriptive distributions, mean median p05 p10 p25 p75 p90 p95
statistics.stability: per-session, rank1..5 and valid/missing breakdown; no rank cutoff

timing.cdf: definite occurrence by t when upper<=t; possible occurrence when lower<=t; session-end includes all valid paths
timing.extremaElapsed: lower/upper elapsed bounds; quantiles for both; report upper-bound median as bar-resolution upper bound
timing.orderedExtremaGap: lower=max(0,later start-earlier end), upper=later end-earlier start; trading and wall minutes; no gap for same-bar
timing.primary: regular trading minutes from selection; exclude 11:30-12:30 lunch
timing.timestamps: bar start/end interval in JST, never a fabricated point timestamp

winners.definition: selectionToHigh>=threshold with 1e-10 numeric tolerance on complete paths
winners.groups: winner and nonwinner separately for every threshold; +3/+5 detailed; invalid paths unknown, never nonwinner
